messages:
Maya P.: Quick q — for the /v1/generate route, how should clients interpret 429s if they hit a burst? global vs per-route?
Samir: We talked about per-customer quotas and per-route soft limits in the design doc. 429 semantics need to be explicit. currently it's per-route by default, but there's a global account quota too.
Luca: My vote: 429 should indicate the specific limit that was hit. include headers to disambiguate (route vs account).
Anna: Agreed. otherwise client retries may thrash unrelated endpoints. also need a clear Retry-After semantics for backoff.
Jonathan: Can we avoid breaking existing users? older clients expect Retry-After as seconds. If we change to timestamps we should support both formats for a while.
Samir: Plan: respond with Retry-After (seconds) for now, and add Retry-After-At (RFC3339) as opt-in header in a beta rollout. Keep Retry-After for backward compat.
Maya P.: Nice. What headers exactly? suggest minimal set: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-RateLimit-Resource?
Luca: I prefer names that match common patterns: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (unix epoch). Add X-RateLimit-Scope or X-RateLimit-Resource to say "account" or "route".
Anna: Also include X-RateLimit-Policy to indicate burst allowance, e.g., "burst: 20, interval:60s" — that helps clients adapt.
Jonathan: Example 429 payload we can standardize on? small JSON with reason + scope + retry_after?
Samir: Example payload: ```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "scope": "route",
  "retry_after_seconds": 12
}
```
Maya P.: That looks good. Make sure we don't leak internal tokens/ids — scope should be friendly string (route/account).
Luca: For burst handling: server should allow short bursts up to a burst_capacity but decrement both burst and steady counters. Clients should detect X-RateLimit-Remaining dropping below some threshold and slow down preemptively.
Anna: For Dedicated customers we might expose per-tenant header X-RateLimit-Tenant-Remaining and a separate SLA note. keep optional.
rate-limiter-bot: Note: existing clients (sdk v1.x) will parse Retry-After as int seconds. We will maintain that behavior until 2025-01-01.
Jonathan: Ok action items: Samir to update API contract in spec repo with header list + example 429 body; Luca to add unit tests for header emission; Anna to add docs snippet showing client backoff sample; Maya to validate with SDK team that parsing remains compat.
Maya P.: Thanks — can we aim for spec PR by EOD tomorrow? small heads-up in #announcements when we flip the beta header. :thumbsup:
Samir: Yep will do. Ping me if you want to pair on tests.
Anna: will draft docs.
Luca: I'll push test branch after lunch.
Samir: marking followups in the ticket.
rate-limiter-bot: Deploybot: rate-limiter service deployed v1.12.3 to staging (sha: abc123) — tests queued.
Maya P.: Perfect, closing thread for now unless someone has blocking concerns.
